run_model_chat_task: run a model chat crowdsourcing task with a mephisto config and task directory
run_task_with_qualifications: run a model chat task with worker qualification requirements and a world module
run_task_local_sandbox: run a model chat task on local or mturk sandbox with auto task name suffix
soft_block_mturk_workers: soft block mturk workers using a task-specific block qualification name
create_shared_model_chat_state: create a SharedModelChatTaskState with optional qualifications for the model chat blueprint
